title: ARC Control Action
description: An action is a single thing an agent asked to do. It is recorded before any decision is made, so a denied action is as durable as an executed one — the attempt is itself the security signal.

parametersDigest.description: Digest over the canonical form of the parameters as submitted, before redaction.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-supplied key. A repeat with the same key and parameters returns the original outcome rather than acting twice; a repeat with different parameters is refused.

intent.description: Free-text intent from the agent. Advisory only: never used in policy decisions, because an agent's own account of its intent is not evidence.

correlationId.description: Ties the action to an agent run or upstream trace.
